title: translation rendering
description: One named translator's exact rendering of one term at one locus, grounded to a citekey this section can trace to a source. Not itself a term — a structural building block $ref'd by translation-variance-record.schema.json, the same way category.schema.json is a building block $ref'd by functor.schema.json rather than a term in its own right.

citekey.description: the surnameYYYY citekey resolving to this section's content/text/documents/articles/bibliographies/<citekey>.md carrier and to the citing term's frontmatter references: map

translator.description: the translator's name as credited on the cited edition

year.description: first-publication year of the cited edition

rendering.description: the exact quoted English rendering, verbatim, of the locus this record is about

note.description: an optional, honestly-scoped observation about this specific rendering — never a claim about a translator's intent this section has not sourced

grounding.description: how this rendering was checked before being recorded here — named plainly so an ungrounded quote is never indistinguishable from a checked one
